# Freedom Works

> Freedom Works is a global creative agency offering brand strategy, brand identity, creative, production, and in-house creative. It brings together The Guild, a network of more than 500 award-winning independent creatives, strategists, and producers across 37 countries and cultures, and Culture3, its cultural partnerships business, to build a handpicked team for every brief. Founded by Jon Williams. London.

## About
- [About Freedom Works](https://freedom.works/agency/): the model, our DNA, and the leadership team
- [The Guild](https://freedom.works/the-guild/): 500+ independent creatives, strategists, and producers in 37 countries and cultures
- [Culture3](https://freedom.works/culture3/): cultural partnerships, Offstage, A Culture3 Conversation, and TED partnerships
- [Contact](https://freedom.works/contact/): hello@freedom.works

## Services
- [All services](https://freedom.works/services/)
- [Brand strategy](https://freedom.works/services/brand-strategy/): Positioning, communications strategy, and brand architecture.
- [Brand positioning](https://freedom.works/services/brand-strategy/brand-positioning/): The space in the market your brand can own, and the words to claim it.
- [Communications strategy](https://freedom.works/services/brand-strategy/communications-strategy/): Who to reach, what will move them, and where to say it.
- [Brand architecture](https://freedom.works/services/brand-strategy/brand-architecture/): A clear job for every brand in your portfolio.
- [Brand identity](https://freedom.works/services/brand-identity/): The name, the look, and the voice that make a brand unmistakable.
- [Brand development and rebranding](https://freedom.works/services/brand-identity/brand-development-and-rebranding/): Keep what people love. Fix what holds the brand back.
- [Naming](https://freedom.works/services/brand-identity/naming/): Names people remember, and lawyers approve.
- [Visual identity and brand guidelines](https://freedom.works/services/brand-identity/visual-identity-and-brand-guidelines/): A visual system, and the guidelines that keep it right.
- [Creative](https://freedom.works/services/creative/): Ideas that span channels and cultures, and move the numbers.
- [Brand and product launches](https://freedom.works/services/creative/brand-and-product-launches/): Launch campaigns that make an entrance, and keep the momentum.
- [Digital and social creative](https://freedom.works/services/creative/digital-and-social-creative/): Platform-first ideas that earn attention in the feed.
- [Campaign strategy and development](https://freedom.works/services/creative/campaign-strategy-and-development/): One idea, planned to work across channels and markets.
- [Production](https://freedom.works/services/production/): Film, design, post-production, and virtual and AI production.
- [Film and video](https://freedom.works/services/production/film-and-video/): Commercials, brand films, and social content people want to watch.
- [Design](https://freedom.works/services/production/design/): Campaign, packaging, print, digital, and retail design.
- [Virtual production](https://freedom.works/services/production/virtual-production/): Real-time environments that take the shoot anywhere.
- [Post-production](https://freedom.works/services/production/post-production/): Edit, colour, sound, VFX, and versioning for every format.
- [AI production](https://freedom.works/services/production/ai-production/): AI-made film, imagery, and content, directed by humans.
- [In-house creative](https://freedom.works/services/in-house/): Senior creative firepower for in-house teams.

## Thinking
- [All articles](https://freedom.works/thinking/): 136 articles
- [AI and creativity](https://freedom.works/thinking/ai-and-creativity/): What AI changes for creativity, and what it never will. Our thinking on using AI for process and production, while people stay in charge of the ideas.
- [The agency model](https://freedom.works/thinking/the-agency-model/): How agencies are built, paid, and run, and why the old model is creaking. Our thinking on independent talent, charging for ideas, and building an agency fit for the next ten years.
- [Talent and work](https://freedom.works/thinking/talent-and-work/): The people who make the work, and how they want to work. Our thinking on independent talent, distributed teams, and getting the best creative minds onto every brief.
- [Culture and advertising](https://freedom.works/thinking/culture-and-advertising/): Where brands meet culture, and what it takes to earn a place there. Our thinking on campaigns, cultural moments, and the ideas that get people talking.
- [Purpose](https://freedom.works/thinking/purpose/): Purpose that’s real, and purpose that’s just words. Our thinking on brands, responsibility, and doing good in a way people believe.
